root_cause: PR #35433 modifies moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp to add case branches for new GPU architecture enum values (xe3p_35_10, xe3p_35_11, xe3p_unknown) in cldnn::gpu_arch. However, these enum values are not yet defined in the cldnn::gpu_arch enum type visible in the manylinux_2_28 build environment. The PR likely depends on a companion change to the gpu_arch enum definition that has not yet landed, or the enum definition exists in a different branch/header not included in this build configuration.
reproduction_steps: Build the intel_gpu plugin targeting manylinux 2_28 with PR #35433 applied and verify the cldnn::gpu_arch enum definition in the relevant header does not include xe3p_35_10, xe3p_35_11, or xe3p_unknown.
recommended_actions: Add xe3p_35_10, xe3p_35_11, and xe3p_unknown to the cldnn::gpu_arch enum definition before this PR can build successfully.
Review whether this PR is missing a prerequisite change that defines the new enum values.
If the enum values are defined in another PR, ensure that PR merges first before re-queuing this one.
prevention_strategies: When adding new enum values to cldnn::gpu_arch, ensure the enum definition header is updated atomically in the same PR as any code referencing the new values.
